一句话，记下物品和位置。免费版可记录 50 种物品。一次性买断后，物品种类不限，并可使用加密备份。

01协议说明

本使用说明是你与该应用提供者之间关于「东西放哪」的约定。继续使用即表示你同意这些条款。若不同意，请停止使用并删除本应用。

02使用许可

你获得的是在自己的设备上、为自己和家庭使用本应用的个人许可。该许可不可转让。应用本身仍归应用开发者所有。

03产品与服务

「东西放哪」用来记下家里的东西放在哪里、还有多少。现在按单机使用，暂无账号，记录保存在你的手机上。现在不支持多设备的数据同步。不会使用或出售你的信息。没有广告。免费版不能使用备份。买断后可以在「备份」里打开。语音识别和帮助改进是否使用，以设置里的开关为准。识别和查找可能听错或记错。本应用不是防丢保险，也不是财务、医疗或仓储审计工具。

04使用规则

请用于个人和家庭记录。你对自己写下的物品名和位置负责。请勿记录你无权保存的他人信息，也请勿干扰语音和网络服务。

05条款更新

本使用说明会随应用版本更新，新文本展示在应用内。更新之后继续使用，即表示你接受当时展示的条款。若不同意，请停止使用并删除本应用。

06变更、中断与终止

功能会随版本更新。系统、网络或语音服务中断时，相关能力会暂停，手机上已经记下的内容仍在。你可以随时删除本应用。停止提供本应用时，手机里的记录仍由你保管；你做过的备份留在你选择的位置，直到你自己删除。

07知识产权

应用名称、界面和文案归应用开发者所有。你记录的物品名、位置和原话归你。你寄到邮箱的反馈可以用来改进产品；公开改进结果时不会写出你的身份。

08免责

因听错、记错、没有找到物品、漏买，或备份文件损坏、无法打开，造成的不便或损失，本应用不承担责任。语音识别、iCloud 和你选择的文件夹，按其自身的规则运行。法律不允许排除的权利仍然保留。

09其他条款

免费版最多记录 50 种物品，没有广告，不能使用备份。查找、使用、挪动、删除，以及查看、修改已有记录，都不限次数。付费版通过 App Store 一次性买断，物品种类不限，可以使用备份。同一个 Apple ID 可以在其他设备上恢复购买。购买和退款按 App Store 的规则办理。退款后回到免费版，已有记录仍可使用。

10适用法律

本说明适用你使用本应用所在地不能约定排除的法律。对条款有争议时，请先写信到下方的联系邮箱。某一条如果无效，其余条款仍然有效。

11如何联系我们

协议、隐私和产品问题请写到 whereabout.feedback@gmail.com。

12更新日期

本使用说明于 2026年10月25日更新。此后若有修改，以应用内展示的文本为准。

需要帮助？

隐私、条款或使用上的问题，都可以写信给我们。

whereabout.feedback@gmail.com

An item and a place. Just say it.Record up to 50 kinds of items for free. A one-time purchase removes the limit and unlocks encrypted backup.

01Agreement

These terms are between you and the provider of this app for Whereabout. Continuing to use the app means you agree. If you do not agree, stop using it and delete it.

02License

You receive a personal, non-transferable license to use this app on your own devices for your household. The app itself remains the app developer's.

03The service

The app helps you remember where things are at home and how many remain. It is used on this device alone for now, and there is no account. Records stay on your iPhone. Syncing data across devices is not supported now. Your information is not used or sold. There are no ads. The free plan can’t use backup. After you buy the paid plan, you can turn backup on. Speech recognition and Help Improve follow the switches in Settings. Recognition and search can be wrong. The app is not loss insurance, and it is not a financial, medical, or warehouse-audit tool.

04Use

Use it for your own household notes. You are responsible for the item names and places you record. Do not store other people’s information without the right to do so, and do not interfere with speech or network services.

05Changes to these terms

These terms change when the app is updated. The new text appears in the app. If you keep using the app after an update, you accept the terms then shown. If you do not agree, stop using the app and delete it.

06Changes, interruption, and ending

Features change as the app is updated. When the system, network, or speech service is unavailable, that part pauses. Notes already on the phone remain. You may delete the app at any time. If the app is withdrawn, the notes on your phone stay in your care. A backup you made stays where you saved it until you delete that file.

07Intellectual property

The app name, interface, and text belong to the app developer. The item names, places, and words you record belong to you. Mail you send may be used to improve the app. Public notes about those improvements will not name you.

08Disclaimer

The app is not responsible for inconvenience or loss from a misheard phrase, a wrong note, a missing item, a missed purchase, or a backup that is damaged or will not open. Speech recognition, iCloud, and the folder you choose follow their own rules. Rights that the law does not allow to be waived still apply.

09Other terms

The free version records up to 50 kinds of items, has no ads, and can’t use backup. Looking items up, using them, moving them, deleting them, and viewing or editing records you already have are not limited. The paid plan is a one-time purchase on the App Store. It removes the limit and includes backup. The same Apple ID can restore the purchase on another device. Purchases and refunds follow the App Store. After a refund, the app returns to the free plan, and records you already have stay available.

10Governing law

These terms follow the mandatory law of the place where you use the app. If you have a dispute about these terms, write to the contact address below first. If one term is unenforceable, the rest still apply.

11Contact

For these terms, privacy, or the product, write to whereabout.feedback@gmail.com.

12Updated

These terms were updated on 25 October 2026. If they change, the text shown in the app applies.

Need a hand?

Email us with questions about privacy, these terms, or using the app.
